newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms in European jet consortium talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms in European jet consortium talks.

text.p: Four South Korean companies are in talks with a European aerospace consortium on cooperating in the development of a 70-seat passenger jet, a Samsung Aerospace Industries Co Ltd official said on Tuesday.
Samsung, Daewoo Heavy Industries Industries Ltd, Korean Air Co Ltd and Hyundai Space and Aircraft Co Ltd are in talks with Aero International (Regional), he said.
The official, however, denied local media reports that a memorandum of understanding had been reached between the two groups.

"We are still discussing the matter and no agreement of any kind has been reached yet," the public relations official told Reuters. The official, who declined to be named, said details were unavailable at this time.
Aero International is made up of France's Aerospatiale, Alenia of Italy, and British Aerospace Plc.

The South Korean firms have been actively seeking partners after the collapse of Samsung's bid to takeover Dutch plane maker Fokker NV. A South Korean-China agreement to develop 100-seat jets also failed last year.
